_comment: TEMPLATE, do not edit by hand. Run BOOTSTRAP-PROMPT.md with your agent + the ApparelHub connector; it checks your agency entitlement, creates client-roster.csv, resolves how this runtime sends email, and writes a real state.json next to this file. The single 'clients' entry below is a schema illustration only, the bootstrap replaces it with an empty list. Then fill in the roster and run KICKOFF-PROMPT.md.

account._agency_feature_comment: Set by the bootstrap. This recipe needs it: create_workspace returns feature_unavailable without it.

roster._format_comment: csv (default, readable and writable everywhere) | xlsx (needs openpyxl or pandas in the runtime) | gsheet (readable via the Drive connector, but status columns cannot be written back)

approvals._default_approver_comment: Used for any roster row that leaves approver_email blank.
approvals._outbound_comment: Resolved by the bootstrap. send_tool = this runtime can send email itself, whether via a connector tool or a local module / CLI / SMTP credential invoked through the shell. gmail_draft = it can only create a draft, so the operator clicks send and the agent says so in its run summary.
approvals._send_tool_comment: The exact tool name, command, or import the bootstrap verified for sending. Null when outbound is gmail_draft.

clients._stage_comment: discovered | workspace_ready | identity_pending | identity_ready | concepts_built | creative_sent | creative_approved | products_drafted | golive_sent | delivered | blocked | retired. See constitution.md section 3.
clients._identity_source_comment: existing_assets = inferred from what was already in the folder. generated_interactive = established with the operator or via an intake questionnaire.
